boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain College of the Holy Cross
boards.description: Build an under-21-safe late-night ritual board. Every card needs a currently verifiable destination, a direct source supporting late availability, and a conservative explanation of why it matters near this campus. Do not invent student habits, signature orders, popularity, or current hours. Bars and 21+-only venues are prohibited.

cards.title: Cool Beans
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center
cards.notes: Visit this central campus hub for late-night coffee, smoothies, and milkshakes. It serves as a primary social and study gathering spot for students until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee shop in Hogan Campus Center offering late-night beverages and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Cool Beans is open until 11 p.m. daily and offers smoothies and milkshakes for late-night cravings.
cards.source_title: Cool Beans | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 7:30 a.m.–11 p.m. and Saturday-Sunday 9 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Crossroads
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center
cards.notes: Head to the bottom floor of Hogan for late-night grill favorites like chicken fingers and mozzarella sticks. It often hosts student musical performances at 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A social dining hub on the lower level of Hogan Campus Center featuring a late-night grill.
cards.evidence_claim: Crossroads offers late-night dining options and hosts '10-Spot' musical acts at 10 p.m. on Tuesday nights.
cards.source_title: Crossroads | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: The 1843 Grill within Crossroads provides late-night grab-and-go items; check current seasonal hours for exact closing.

cards.title: Boulevard Diner
cards.subtitle: Shrewsbury Street
cards.notes: Experience a classic 1936 Worcester diner known for serving breakfast all day. It is a long-standing destination for students seeking a traditional diner atmosphere after hours.
cards.short_summary: A historic 24-hour diner on Shrewsbury Street serving classic American breakfast and comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boulevard Diner is open 24 hours a day, providing a kitchen that is always open for late-night meals.
cards.source_title: Late Night Eats - Discover Central MA
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily according to local tourism and business listings.

cards.title: Kenmore Diner
cards.subtitle: Franklin Street
cards.notes: Visit this Canal District staple for late-night coffee and traditional diner fare. It is frequently packed during late-night hours with students and locals.
cards.short_summary: A popular diner in the Canal District offering late-night service on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenmore Diner is open late on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday nights starting at 11 p.m. for late-night dining.
cards.source_title: Kenmore Diner | Worcester MA - Facebook
cards.access_notes: Open for late-night dining Thursday through Saturday nights starting at 11 p.m.

cards.title: Bocado Tapas Wine Bar
cards.subtitle: Winter Street
cards.notes: Share small plates of Spanish cuisine in a warm atmosphere. The full menu of over 40 tapas is available until midnight on weekends for a more upscale late-night option.
cards.short_summary: A Spanish tapas restaurant in the Canal District serving a full menu late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Bocado serves its full menu until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Contact Us - Bocado Tapas Wine Bar
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on Friday and Saturday; until 11 p.m. on other nights.

cards.title: The Fix Burger Bar
cards.subtitle: Grove Street
cards.notes: Build your own custom burger with over 40 toppings or choose a signature 'Fixed-Up' option. This spot is known for its house-made sodas and late-night availability.
cards.short_summary: A specialized burger bar offering custom grinds and house-made sodas until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fix serves burgers and house-made sodas every evening until midnight.
cards.source_title: Late Night Eats - Discover Central MA
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight daily for late-night dining.

cards.title: Antonio's Pizza By The Slice
cards.subtitle: Chandler Street
cards.notes: Grab a quick slice with unique topping combinations at this popular pizza spot. It is a frequent choice for students ordering delivery or visiting late in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A pizza shop known for a wide variety of creative slices and late-night delivery options.
cards.evidence_claim: Antonio's Pizza By The Slice in Worcester offers online ordering and pickup until 11:10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Antonio's Pizza 268 Chandler Street - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Online ordering and pickup available until 11:10 p.m.

cards.title: Wings Over Worcester
cards.subtitle: Kelley Square
cards.notes: Order fresh-made wings and tenders with a variety of sauces. This location in Kelley Square is a staple for late-night chicken cravings and student delivery.
cards.short_summary: A chicken wing and tender specialist offering late-night pickup and delivery in Kelley Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Wings Over Worcester is open for pickup and delivery until 10:45 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Chicken Wings & Tenders Worcester, MA
cards.access_notes: Open daily for pickup and delivery until 10:45 p.m.

cards.title: Lower Kimball Food Court
cards.subtitle: Kimball Hall
cards.notes: Snag grab-and-go items like burritos, sushi, and chicken wings. It is a convenient spot for students on the go between classes or late-night study sessions.
cards.short_summary: An a-la-carte dining area in Kimball Hall featuring various food stations and grab-and-go options.
cards.evidence_claim: Lower Kimball offers a variety of grab-and-go items and is open until 11 p.m. on weekdays.
cards.source_title: Kimball Main Dining Room | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday until 11 p.m. and Saturday-Sunday until 11 p.m. for student dining.

cards.title: Brooks Common Room Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Brooks Hall
cards.notes: Discover this informal student-led dining alternative where international students often prepare meals late at night. It serves as a unique social space for late-night snacks.
cards.short_summary: A student common room kitchen in Brooks Hall known for late-night informal cooking and socializing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brooks Common Room kitchen is noted as a 'hidden gem' for late-night food between 11 p.m. and 3 a.m.
cards.source_title: The Hidden Gem of Holy Cross Dining - The Spire
cards.access_notes: Accessible to residents of Brooks Hall; informal hours typically between 11 p.m. and 3 a.m.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student spaces at the College of the Holy Cross, from late-night study rooms in Dinand Library to the modern gathering spots in the Prior Performing Arts Center.

cards.title: Late Night Study at Dinand
cards.subtitle: Dinand Library
cards.notes: Access the designated 24-hour study space for late-night academic sessions when the main library floors close at midnight.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated 24-hour study area within the main campus library for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Dinand Library offers a 24-hour study space for students, even when main library hours end at midnight.
cards.source_title: Dinand Library | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours for students with valid ID; main library floors typically close at midnight.

cards.title: Gathering in the Beehive
cards.subtitle: Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Visit this three-story architectural atrium for informal gathering, studying, and coffee at the O'Connor Family Cafe.
cards.short_summary: A modern, multi-story atrium designed for student collaboration and relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beehive is a three-story atrium in the Prior Performing Arts Center used for gathering, studying, and rejuvenation.
cards.source_title: Venues - Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; includes the O'Connor Family Cafe for snacks and beverages.

cards.title: Quiet Study in Rehm
cards.subtitle: Smith Hall
cards.notes: Utilize this elegant space for quiet reflection and study when it is not hosting lectures or McFarland Center events.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, modern library space used for both events and individual student study.
cards.evidence_claim: When not in use for events, Rehm Library provides a quiet space for study and reflection.
cards.source_title: Libraries | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Available for study when no scheduled events are taking place.

cards.title: Relaxing on the Hoval
cards.subtitle: Hogan Courtyard
cards.notes: Join students for outdoor gatherings, food truck events, or casual games on this central oval-shaped lawn.
cards.short_summary: The Hogan Courtyard, known as the Hoval, is a popular outdoor social hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hogan Courtyard, affectionately known as the Hoval, is a popular spot for outdoor gatherings and campus events.
cards.source_title: Hogan Campus Center | Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space accessible at all times.

cards.title: Coffee Breaks at Cool Beans
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center, Level 1
cards.notes: Grab a late-night milkshake or morning coffee at this social hub, open until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: A central campus coffee shop and social spot located in the Hogan Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Cool Beans is a social hot spot in Hogan Campus Center open until 11 p.m. for coffee and late-night treats.
cards.source_title: Cool Beans | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Fri 7:30 AM - 11 PM, Sat-Sun 9 AM - 11 PM.

cards.title: Morning Meetings at Cafe Babel
cards.subtitle: Stein Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Coordinate group projects or meet with professors at this popular Starbucks-serving cafe in the main academic building.
cards.short_summary: An academic-centered cafe in Stein Hall serving Starbucks products.
cards.evidence_claim: Cafe Babel is located on the first floor of Stein Hall and is a popular spot for meetings and morning coffee.
cards.source_title: Dining | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open during academic hours; typically closes earlier than Hogan dining spots.

cards.title: Social Hub at Crossroads
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center, Ground Floor
cards.notes: Utilize the lounge area and game room for downtime between classes or late-night study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A multi-functional dining and social space on the bottom floor of the campus center.
cards.evidence_claim: The bottom floor of Hogan houses Crossroads, which includes a game room, lounge area, and grill.
cards.source_title: Hogan Campus Center | Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight daily for food and social use.

cards.title: Science Focused Study
cards.subtitle: Swords Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Find a quiet desk among the science volumes in this library located within the Integrated Science Complex.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library for science disciplines offering quiet study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The O'Callahan Science Library occupies the first floor of Swords Hall and provides dedicated study space.
cards.source_title: Libraries | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; check the library website for seasonal changes.

cards.title: Music Library Retreat
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Hall, East End
cards.notes: Study in a unique environment surrounded by music scores and playback equipment in the historic Fenwick Hall.
cards.short_summary: A specialized music library providing a quiet and unique study atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Located in the east end of Fenwick Hall, the Music Library provides print and electronic music-related materials and study space.
cards.source_title: Libraries | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open during academic hours; accessible to all students for study.

cards.title: Solo Practice with a View
cards.subtitle: Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Reserve one of the four practice rooms, some of which overlook the Beehive atrium, for vocal or instrumental work.
cards.short_summary: Modern practice rooms available for student reservation in the arts center.
cards.evidence_claim: Students are welcome to reserve one of four music practice rooms at The Prior for solo or small group rehearsals.
cards.source_title: Students - Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Reservation required via the Ignite platform; priority for music students.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social spaces and activities at the College of the Holy Cross, from art galleries and historic libraries to outdoor trails and campus traditions.

cards.entity_name: Iris and B. Gerald Cantor Art Gallery
cards.title: View Contemporary Art
cards.subtitle: Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Explore rotating exhibitions of contemporary and historical art. Admission is free and open to the public during gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art gallery featuring diverse rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Cantor Art Gallery | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; check website for current installation closures.

cards.title: Study in the Main Stacks
cards.subtitle: Central Campus
cards.notes: Utilize the main library's extensive collections and quiet study spaces. Public access is available for general use during most operating hours.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus library offering free research and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Our libraries are open to the public for general use (including in-house use of the collection, research databases, etc.) so long as library rules are honored.
cards.source_title: Who can use the Holy Cross libraries? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Public access restricted during the last two hours of operation; students have priority for computers.

cards.title: Visit the Spiritual Heart
cards.subtitle: Linden Lane
cards.notes: Enter this historic 1924 chapel for quiet reflection or to attend free musical performances like the Chapel Artist Series.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus chapel open for reflection and free concerts.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcoming visitors from every faith and background to reflect, pray, or simply sit in peaceful silence.
cards.source_title: St. Joseph Memorial Chapel | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open daily for visitors; check schedule for specific Mass or concert times.

cards.entity_name: Joanne Chouinard-Luth Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.title: Run the Indoor Track
cards.subtitle: Upper Campus
cards.notes: Current students can access the suspended jogging track and fitness equipment at 'The Jo' without additional fees.
cards.short_summary: A student wellness hub featuring a free indoor running track.
cards.evidence_claim: Facilities are accessible to current students, employees and emeriti faculty... Prior to arrival, everyone must sign a one-time, annual Facility Use Waiver.
cards.source_title: Fitness & Recreation | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current students and employees with a valid ID and signed waiver.

cards.title: Attend Outdoor Screenings
cards.subtitle: Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Join the community for free outdoor film screenings and performances at this open-air venue behind the Prior Center.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor amphitheatre hosting free films and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: OUTDOOR FILM SCREENING - Patterson Amphitheatre at The Prior... Admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Events - Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Open-air venue; events are typically seasonal and weather-dependent.

cards.title: Relax in the Living Room
cards.subtitle: Near Dinand Library
cards.notes: Visit the home of the College's chaplains for free snacks, coffee, and a quiet place to study or socialize in a cozy environment.
cards.short_summary: A welcoming campus house offering free snacks and social space.
cards.evidence_claim: Campion House invites everyone in for more than just a cup of coffee or a snack—it's a space where you'll find a listening ear.
cards.source_title: Facilities & Spaces | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; known for 'Wednesday bagels' and a welcoming atmosphere.

cards.title: Join a Pep Rally
cards.subtitle: Kimball Hall Exterior
cards.notes: Participate in free campus-wide events like cheerleader pep rallies and student organization fairs held on the central lawn.
cards.short_summary: A central campus lawn hosting free student rallies and fairs.
cards.evidence_claim: Cheerleader Pep Rally Kimball Quad, 7 - 8 p.m. ... These are just the first of many campus activities and events.
cards.source_title: Welcome Back Events - Holy Cross Magazine
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space; events are typically free for the campus community.

cards.title: Attend Student Performances
cards.subtitle: Hogan Level 3
cards.notes: Catch free performances by student groups, including a cappella concerts and cultural showcases, frequently hosted in the ballroom.
cards.short_summary: A large campus venue for free student-led performances.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hogan Ballroom is full of student leaders... Watch out for upcoming programs and events from over 100+ organizations.
cards.source_title: Holy Cross Office of Student Involvement | Facebook
cards.access_notes: Access typically requires a student ID for indoor events; check myHC for event listings.

cards.title: Walk the Hillside Trails
cards.subtitle: Campus Perimeter
cards.notes: Explore the wooded trails surrounding the upper campus for a free nature walk with views of the Worcester skyline.
cards.short_summary: Free walking trails offering nature access on the campus perimeter.
cards.evidence_claim: Walk one of the several trails around campus... Beautiful green space and a landscaped path for outdoor rec opportunities.
cards.source_title: Fitness & Recreation | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; trails are accessible from various points on the upper campus.

cards.title: Cheer at Home Games
cards.subtitle: Lower Campus
cards.notes: Holy Cross students can attend all regular season home athletic events, including football and baseball games, for free with their ID.
cards.short_summary: Free admission for students to regular season home sports games.
cards.evidence_claim: As a student, attending all regular season home sporting events is free!
cards.source_title: Athletics | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Free for students with valid Holy Cross ID; public tickets require purchase.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover ten distinct study environments across the Holy Cross campus, from the historic reading rooms of Dinand Library to the modern collaborative spaces in the Prior Performing Arts Center.

cards.title: Dinand Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Historic Library Core
cards.notes: Work in a structured, quiet environment with high ceilings and large windows. Ideal for deep concentration and individual focus during peak academic hours.
cards.short_summary: The central, historic reading room of Dinand Library known for its quiet, scholarly atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The main reading room provides a quiet study space essential for developing solid study habits and time management skills.
cards.source_title: Why Studying in the Main Reading Room is Good for the Soul - The Spire
cards.access_notes: Open to students; specific hours vary by semester. Last two hours of operation are restricted to Holy Cross ID holders.

cards.title: Rehm Library
cards.subtitle: Smith Hall
cards.notes: Find a seat in this bright, airy space within Smith Hall. It serves as a quiet venue for study and reflection between lectures and campus forums.
cards.short_summary: A modern, light-filled library and lecture venue located in Smith Hall, used for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Located in Smith Hall, it also provides quiet space for study and reflection, enhanced library resources on religion and spirituality.
cards.source_title: Rehm Library | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during building hours; often used for scheduled events which may limit study availability.

cards.title: The Beehive Atrium
cards.subtitle: Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Utilize flexible work areas in this three-story architectural atrium. It is designed for gathering, studying, and collaborative arts-based projects.
cards.short_summary: A central, multi-level hub for study and collaboration within the Prior Performing Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The heart of the building, 'The Beehive' is a playground for study and performance, encouraging collaboration via flexible work spaces.
cards.source_title: Venues | Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community; includes the O'Connor Family Cafe for snacks while studying.

cards.title: O'Callahan Science Library
cards.subtitle: Swords Hall
cards.notes: Study in spacious cubicles or reserve private rooms with whiteboards. This STEM-focused library occupies the first floor of Swords Hall.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated science library offering quiet cubicles and group study rooms with whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: The Science Library occupies the entire first floor of Swords Hall, the central portion of the five-building Integrated Science Complex.
cards.source_title: Libraries | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Standard library hours apply; group study rooms can be reserved by students.

cards.title: Fenwick Music Library
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Hall
cards.notes: Access a quiet, sun-drenched space in the east end of Fenwick Hall. It features study tables and playback equipment for music-related research.
cards.short_summary: A specialized music library in Fenwick Hall known for its quiet atmosphere and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: Founded in 1978 and located in the east end of Fenwick Hall, the Music Library collection supports the music department curriculum.
cards.source_title: Libraries | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Designated as a strict quiet zone; no cell phone use permitted within the library space.

cards.title: O'Kane Hallway Seating
cards.subtitle: O'Kane Hall, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Use the seating options outside the Enrollment Welcome Center for quick breaks or focused study sessions in a high-traffic campus corridor.
cards.short_summary: Modern seating areas in the O'Kane Hall corridor designed for student study and breaks.
cards.evidence_claim: Seating options that span the O'Kane 1 hallway outside the Enrollment Welcome Center provide a space for current students to hunker down for a study session.
cards.source_title: Holy Cross Opens Its New Front Door
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; located in a public hallway near the campus tour starting point.

cards.title: Dinand Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Dinand Library Basement
cards.notes: Reserve a private room for up to two hours for collaborative projects. These rooms are located on the basement level and allow cell phone use.
cards.short_summary: Reservable private rooms in Dinand Library intended for group work and discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: Use this form to reserve a study room in Dinand Library. Each reservation has a two hour maximum.
cards.source_title: Search Spaces - Dinand Library - LibCal
cards.access_notes: Reservations can be made seven days in advance; Holy Cross ID required for booking.

cards.title: Hogan Center Lounges
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center
cards.notes: Study in a more social atmosphere near Cool Beans or Crossroads. The center offers various lounge areas and flexible seating for casual work.
cards.short_summary: Social study and lounge spaces located within the main campus activity hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The bottom floor of the campus center houses a game room, lounge area, grill and pub.
cards.source_title: Hogan Campus Center | Welcome to the College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open late; typically more noise than library spaces due to dining and student activities.

cards.title: O'Neil Hall Lounge
cards.subtitle: Integrated Science Complex
cards.notes: Utilize the whiteboard for problem-solving in this dedicated student lounge. It provides a convenient spot for STEM students between labs.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge in O'Neil Hall equipped with whiteboards for collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: I spend most of my time either there or in O'Neil, which has a student lounge with a whiteboard.
cards.source_title: A Comprehensive Guide to the Science Complex - The Spire
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students within the science complex during building hours.

cards.title: The Stacks
cards.subtitle: Dinand Library
cards.notes: Find a private cubicle among the book collections for maximum quiet. This area is ideal for individual work requiring minimal distractions.
cards.short_summary: Quiet, individual study cubicles located within the book stacks of Dinand Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The stacks are great, because they are one of the quietest locations on campus and are very conducive to work.
cards.source_title: The 5 Best Study Spots at Holy Cross - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Cell phone reception may be limited in lower levels; open during standard library hours.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the streets and corridors immediately surrounding the College of the Holy Cross, from the industrial history of Southbridge Street to the student-frequented eateries of Shrewsbury Street.

cards.title: The Gateway Corridor
cards.subtitle: Southbridge Street
cards.notes: Walk past the former Rotmans Furniture site, a 14-acre landmark recently acquired by the college for future campus expansion and neighborhood revitalization.
cards.short_summary: A major industrial and commercial corridor serving as the primary gateway to the Holy Cross campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Holy Cross and Madison Properties purchased the former Rotmans Furniture property at 725 Southbridge Street to serve the college's core mission.
cards.source_title: Holy Cross and Madison Properties Purchase Former Rotmans Furniture Property in Worcester
cards.access_notes: Public street access; the specific Rotmans site is currently under master planning for future use.

cards.title: The Main Approach
cards.subtitle: College Street
cards.notes: Ascend the hill toward the main gate, passing the Ciocca Center for Business, Ethics and Society located at the base of the campus.
cards.short_summary: The primary residential and academic artery connecting the South Worcester neighborhood to the campus gates.
cards.evidence_claim: The College of the Holy Cross is located at 1 College Street, which serves as the main address and entry point.
cards.source_title: Maps and Directions | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Public roadway providing the main vehicular and pedestrian access to the college.

cards.title: The Nature Link
cards.subtitle: McKeon Road
cards.notes: Access the Blackstone Gateway Park from this road, which features a half-mile of accessible boardwalks and bridges over the Middle River.
cards.short_summary: A southern perimeter road that connects the campus to regional recreational trails and the Blackstone River Valley.
cards.evidence_claim: Blackstone Gateway Park connects the Visitor Center to the McKeon Road entrance to the Holy Cross campus.
cards.source_title: Holy Cross Celebrates Opening of Visitors Center and Park Near Campus
cards.access_notes: Public road with direct access to the Blackstone Heritage Corridor Visitor Center.

cards.title: Restaurant Row
cards.subtitle: Shrewsbury Street
cards.notes: Visit this mile-long stretch for student favorites like Volturno for wood-fired pizza or InHouse Coffee for study sessions.
cards.short_summary: Worcester's premier dining destination, located a short drive from campus and popular for student outings.
cards.evidence_claim: Shrewsbury Street is a mile-and-a-half long street home to 32 restaurants and is a favorite off-campus spot for students.
cards.source_title: Tour Guides Favorite Spots Off-Campus
cards.access_notes: Public commercial street; most businesses are open daily with varying hours.

cards.title: Senior Living Block
cards.subtitle: City View Street
cards.notes: Walk past the newly constructed senior-only townhouses that offer apartment-style living on the northern edge of campus.
cards.short_summary: A residential street on the campus periphery recently developed into high-density student housing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Townhouses, located on the corner of City View and College Street, opened in 2023 as a senior-only residence hall.
cards.source_title: Townhouses | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Public street; townhouse interiors are restricted to residents and guests.

cards.title: The Cookson Field Entry
cards.subtitle: Kendig Street
cards.notes: Find the entrance to Cookson Field, an 18-acre wooded park that the college and city collaborated to rehabilitate for community use.
cards.short_summary: A quiet residential street providing access to one of the neighborhood's largest undeveloped green spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Cookson Field is located on Kendig Street (off College Street) and consists of approximately 18 acres of wooded space.
cards.source_title: Holy Cross and City Announce Development of Master Plan to Rehabilitate Cookson Field
cards.access_notes: Public street access to the park; park is open dawn to dusk.

cards.title: The South Worcester Hub
cards.subtitle: Cambridge Street
cards.notes: Explore the local businesses and community services in this district, which connects the college to the wider South Worcester area.
cards.short_summary: A major cross-town thoroughfare that serves as a commercial anchor for the neighborhood surrounding the college.
cards.evidence_claim: The South Worcester neighborhood, including the Cambridge Street area, is part of the college's community outreach and planning efforts.
cards.source_title: Worcester & Beyond | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare with numerous retail and service businesses.

cards.title: The Canal District Edge
cards.subtitle: Millbury Street
cards.notes: Walk toward the Canal District to find the Worcester Public Market and various local eateries popular with the student body.
cards.short_summary: An evolving commercial street that links the college area to the historic and trendy Canal District.
cards.evidence_claim: Students frequent spots like Pasta Mani in the Worcester Public Market, which is located in the nearby Canal District area.
cards.source_title: Favorite Coffee Shops and Local Places to Eat in Worcester
cards.access_notes: Public street; market hours vary by vendor but generally open daily.

cards.title: The Historic Hilltop
cards.subtitle: Pakachoag Street
cards.notes: Visit the Pakachoag Center for Arts, Recreation, Spirituality, and Culture, located just over the town line in Auburn.
cards.short_summary: A historic road on Pakachoag Hill, the original site of the Nipmuc people and the foundation of the college.
cards.evidence_claim: The land was originally known as Pakachoag Hill and is home to the Pakachoag Center at 203 Pakachoag St.
cards.source_title: Welcome | Pakachoag Center
cards.access_notes: Public street; center hours depend on scheduled programs and events.

cards.title: The Urban Village
cards.subtitle: Green Street
cards.notes: Explore the heart of the Canal District, featuring the new Polar Park stadium and a variety of student-friendly cafes like Nu Kitchen.
cards.short_summary: A vibrant urban street known for its revitalization, sports venues, and diverse dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: Nu Cafe (Nu Kitchen) is a crowd pleaser and a go-to off-campus spot for students, located in the Green Street area.
cards.source_title: Favorite Coffee Shops and Local Places to Eat in Worcester
cards.access_notes: Public street; very walkable with high pedestrian activity during game days.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique spiritual rituals, campus legends, and seasonal celebrations that define the Crusader experience at Mount St. James.

cards.title: Midnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Kimball Dining Hall
cards.notes: During finals week, deans and administrators serve late-night breakfast to students in Kimball Hall to provide a stress-relieving study break.
cards.short_summary: A finals week tradition where college leadership serves breakfast to students at midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Midnight Breakfast is a beloved tradition held during finals season where faculty and administrators serve students breakfast at midnight.
cards.source_title: College Traditions | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Occurs at midnight during final exam periods in December and May.

cards.title: Climbing the Stairs to Nowhere
cards.subtitle: Fenwick and O'Kane Halls
cards.notes: Students visit the fourth-floor staircase that ends at a locked door, fueling legends of a secret 'Exorcism Room' in the clock tower.
cards.short_summary: A campus legend involving a staircase that leads to a rumored supernatural room.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Stairs to Nowhere' lead to a locked door on the fourth floor of Fenwick and O'Kane Halls, associated with the 'Exorcism Room' legend.
cards.source_title: It Scares Us To Death — And We Love It | Holy Cross Magazine
cards.access_notes: The staircase is accessible within the academic building; the room itself is typically locked.

cards.title: Mass of the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Fitton Football Stadium
cards.notes: This signature tradition takes place on first-year move-in day, welcoming new students and families with a formal outdoor liturgy.
cards.short_summary: A formal welcoming Mass held outdoors for the incoming first-year class.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mass of the Holy Spirit is a signature tradition that takes place on first-year student move-in day at Fitton Football Stadium.
cards.source_title: College Traditions | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Held annually in August on the first-year move-in date.

cards.entity_name: Advent Festival of Lessons and Carols
cards.title: Advent Festival of Lessons and Carols
cards.subtitle: St. Joseph Memorial Chapel
cards.notes: A beloved December tradition since 1978 featuring scripture readings and seasonal music by the College Choir in the historic chapel.
cards.short_summary: An annual holiday service of music and scripture held in St. Joseph Memorial Chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Lessons and Carols has been a holiday tradition at Holy Cross since 1978, held in St. Joseph Memorial Chapel.
cards.source_title: St. Joseph Memorial Chapel | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; typically held on a Thursday evening in early December.

cards.title: Christmas Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: O'Kane Porch
cards.notes: Sponsored by the Purple Key Society, this event features musical performances, hot chocolate, and a visit from Santa Claus.
cards.short_summary: The annual lighting of the campus Christmas tree on the O'Kane Hall porch.
cards.evidence_claim: The annual Christmas tree lighting ceremony is sponsored by the Purple Key Society and takes place on the O'Kane porch.
cards.source_title: Holy Cross to Celebrate the Holiday Season | Holy Cross News
cards.access_notes: Held annually in early December; open to the campus community and public.

cards.title: Holy Cross Cares Day
cards.subtitle: Worcester Community
cards.notes: A student-organized day of service where hundreds of volunteers perform community work like painting and raking throughout Worcester.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale annual community service event organized by students.
cards.evidence_claim: Holy Cross Cares Day is a completely student-organized event where volunteers perform service throughout the city of Worcester.
cards.source_title: Hundreds of Students Fan Across City for Day of Service | Holy Cross News
cards.access_notes: Typically held on a Saturday in late March or early April.

cards.title: Spring Weekend Carnival
cards.subtitle: Kimball Quad
cards.notes: The end-of-year celebration features carnival rides, games, inflatables, and fried dough for the student body.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring carnival held on campus as part of Spring Weekend festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: Spring Weekend includes Springfest which brings rides, games and inflatables to campus, often held on Kimball Quad.
cards.source_title: College Traditions | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Held annually in May before final exams.

cards.title: Purple Pride Day
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide
cards.notes: A spring celebration hosted by the Purple Key Society featuring pop-up events and giveaways to celebrate school spirit.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated day for celebrating school spirit with campus-wide activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Purple Pride Day is hosted by the Purple Key Society each spring as a one-day celebration for the campus.
cards.source_title: College Traditions | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually in the spring semester.

cards.title: Kimball Friday Donuts
cards.subtitle: Kimball Main Dining Room
cards.notes: Every Friday, the Kimball Sweet Shoppe serves signature housemade donuts, a weekly highlight for the campus community.
cards.short_summary: A weekly tradition of fresh housemade donuts served every Friday in the dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Signature housemade donuts are available at Kimball Hall every Friday.
cards.source_title: Kimball Main Dining Room | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Available during Friday dining hours; requires meal plan or door price for entry.

cards.title: Winter Weekend Bear Stuffing
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center
cards.notes: A popular activity during the annual Winter Weekend where students can create and stuff their own plush bears.
cards.short_summary: A festive winter activity where students make plush bears on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Winter Weekend features activities like bear-stuffing, mug-making, and a holiday shop.
cards.source_title: Marie Meisner '26 - Holy Cross Blogs
cards.access_notes: Held during the annual Winter Weekend in December.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at College of the Holy Cross, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Navigate your first days on Mount St. James with this sequence of essential campus spots and orientation traditions.

cards.title: Arrive at Mount St. James
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide tradition
cards.notes: Experience the tradition where upperclassmen volunteers help carry all your belongings into your residence hall room.
cards.short_summary: A welcoming tradition where student volunteers assist new arrivals with their luggage.
cards.evidence_claim: New students experience a tradition where older students volunteer to help them bring belongings into their dorm rooms.
cards.source_title: What Are Some Traditions at the College of the Holy Cross?
cards.access_notes: Occurs on the designated first-year move-in Wednesday in August.

cards.title: First Meal at Kimball
cards.subtitle: The Hill's central dining hall
cards.notes: Visit this historic all-you-care-to-eat hall for your first campus meal; don't miss the signature housemade donuts on Fridays.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall offering a variety of food stations in a classic collegiate setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Kimball Main Dining Room offers all-you-care-to-eat service and signature housemade donuts every Friday.
cards.source_title: Kimball Main Dining Room | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open daily; weekend brunch typically starts at 10:00 AM.

cards.title: Relax on the Hoval
cards.subtitle: Hogan Courtyard
cards.notes: Gather at this oval-shaped courtyard for outdoor events or to enjoy the view of the Worcester skyline.
cards.short_summary: An iconic oval-shaped green space used for student gatherings and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hoval, or Hogan Courtyard, is a popular spot for outdoor gatherings and campus events with views of the Worcester skyline.
cards.source_title: Webcams | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Late Night at Cool Beans
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center coffee shop
cards.notes: Grab a late-night milkshake or smoothie at this social hub, open until 11:00 PM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee shop known for breakfast sandwiches, smoothies, and late-night milkshakes.
cards.evidence_claim: Cool Beans is open until 11 PM on Saturdays and Sundays and offers smoothies and milkshakes.
cards.source_title: Cool Beans | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM daily during the academic year.

cards.title: Visit the Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: The spiritual heart of campus
cards.notes: Explore this century-old architectural landmark, which hosts Sunday evening Mass at 7:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: A historic chapel dedicated to alumni lost in wars, serving as a center for worship and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Joseph Memorial Chapel hosts Sunday Mass at 7:30 PM when classes are in session.
cards.source_title: St. Joseph Memorial Chapel | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open for visitors and scheduled services; Sunday evening Mass is a popular student time.

cards.title: Join Gateways Sessions
cards.subtitle: New student transition program
cards.notes: Participate in your first-year orientation sessions to meet your classmates and learn about campus life.
cards.short_summary: The mandatory orientation program for all incoming students to facilitate their transition to college.
cards.evidence_claim: All new students participate in Gateways Orientation to settle into campus and make connections.
cards.source_title: Orientation | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students during the first week of arrival.

cards.title: Explore Historic Fenwick
cards.subtitle: The heart of Holy Cross
cards.notes: Walk through the oldest building on campus, rebuilt in 1853, which houses administrative offices and classrooms.
cards.short_summary: The foundational building of the college, named after founder Bishop Benedict Joseph Fenwick.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenwick Hall is the second-oldest building on campus and is described as the heart of Holy Cross.
cards.source_title: Fenwick Hall: Changes and Trials by Fire
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic and administrative hours.

cards.entity_name: Hart Center at the Luth Athletic Complex
cards.title: Visit the Hart Center
cards.subtitle: Athletics and recreation hub
cards.notes: Check out the fitness facilities or catch a game at this renovated complex overlooking the city.
cards.short_summary: The primary athletic facility on campus, housing a basketball arena, hockey rink, and pool.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hart Center at the Luth Athletic Complex serves as the centerpiece for athletics and recreation at Holy Cross.
cards.source_title: Hart Center at the Luth Athletic Complex - Facilities
cards.access_notes: Student access requires a valid Crusader Card.

cards.title: Celebrate at Mulledy Beach
cards.subtitle: Welcome weekend event
cards.notes: Join the late-night celebration featuring obstacle courses, music, and ice cream on the lawn.
cards.short_summary: An annual orientation event held on the Mulledy Beach lawn to welcome new students.
cards.evidence_claim: The First Night Celebration at Mulledy Beach features an adrenaline obstacle course, DJ, and ice cream.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend Events - Holy Cross Magazine
cards.access_notes: Typically held from 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM on the first Saturday of the semester.

cards.title: Play in the Game Room
cards.subtitle: Hogan Ground Floor
cards.notes: Head to the bottom floor of the campus center to find the game room and lounge area for weekend downtime.
cards.short_summary: A recreational space for students located on the lower level of the main campus center.
cards.evidence_claim: The bottom floor of the Hogan Campus Center houses a game room and lounge area.
cards.source_title: Hogan Campus Center
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Hogan Campus Center operating hours.
